## 【投喂单元 1/4】
duration: 12
subject_definitions:
<Subject> A_Qingsi: Next-gen 3D semi-realistic female character, ethereal immortal aesthetic. Long dark hair initially greasy and clumped, dull luster. Wearing a moon-white wide-sleeved flowing dress with silver cloud embroidery at collar and pale cyan sash at waist. Slender build, 7.5 head-body ratio. Voice: Ethereal, Clear, Soft Female Voice.
</Subject>
<Subject> Liu_Gongzi: Next-gen 3D semi-realistic male scholar/warrior hybrid. Black hair tied in crown, neat. Wearing blue Confucian robe of heavy cotton-linen blend, worn cuffs, dust on hem, dark brown leather belt. Lean tall build, defined muscle lines. Voice: Young, Urgent, Clear Male Voice.
</Subject>
<Subject> Ancient_Tower_Interior: Dim enclosed tower top interior. Rough stone floor, ancient brick walls, weathered thick stone pillars at four corners, broken railings, scattered debris. Tyndall light beams piercing through mist from ceiling cracks. Cold grey-brown tone, floating dust particles visible.
</Subject>
summary:
Inside the dim ancient tower top, Liu_Gongzi attempts to climb down using A_Qingsi's long hair as a rope but fails because her hair is too greasy and sticky. He struggles painfully while she looks on with regret. The scene establishes the problem: oily hair prevents rescue.
retention_analysis:
Character consistency maintained via Picture 1 (A_Qingsi) and Picture 2 (Liu_Gongzi). Spatial layout locked by Picture 3 (Ancient_Tower_Interior). Lighting direction consistent: top-down natural light creating strong contrast. Hair texture state: initial greasy/clumped condition preserved throughout this unit. fully_preserved
[Audio Retention]: fully_copy
detailed_description:
Camera starts with a medium shot of Liu_Gongzi gripping A_Qingsi's hair bundle, straining upwards. Close-up inserts show the greasy strands clumping together, refusing to separate or slide smoothly. Liu_Gongzi slips back down, gasping. Cut to A_Qingsi's face, showing mild embarrassment and concern as she watches his futile struggle. Background remains static within the tower interior, emphasizing the isolation.
overall_soundscape:
Ambient low-frequency hum of wind outside the tower. Sharp, strained breathing sounds from Liu_Gongzi. Subtle rustling of fabric against stone. No dialogue in this segment, focusing on physical effort and environmental tension.
non_diegetic_music:
Tense, minimal string plucks underscore the failure of the action. Slow tempo, minor key, highlighting the awkwardness and urgency without overpowering the ambient sounds.

## 【投喂单元 2/4】
duration: 14
subject_definitions:
<Subject> A_Qingsi: Next-gen 3D semi-realistic female character. Hair transitioning from greasy to clean/fluffy during action. Holding small porcelain tea bottle prop.
</Subject>
<Subject> Liu_Gongzi: Next-gen 3D semi-realistic male character. Expression shifting from pain to surprise.
</Subject>
<Subject> Tea_Bottle_Prop: Small elegant ceramic bottle, translucent celadon glaze, smooth reflective surface, wooden cap texture, engraved "100年润发" characters clearly visible, pale green liquid inside emitting faint glow. Height approx 12cm, diameter 4cm.
</Subject>
<Subject> Ancient_Tower_Interior: Same as previous unit.
</Subject>
summary:
A_Qingsi produces the '100 Year Lush' oil-control tea bottle and applies its contents to her hair and contact points. The liquid works instantly: bubbles form, grease dissolves, hair separates and becomes fluffy, dry, and silky. Liu_Gongzi tests the newly cleaned hair and finds it perfectly suitable for climbing.
retention_analysis:
Prop consistency enforced via Picture 5 (Tea_Bottle_Prop). Character states evolve logically: hair transitions from greasy (Unit 1 end) to clean/fluffy (Unit 2 end). Lighting shifts subtly warmer as tension resolves. Spatial positions remain stable: A_Qingsi left, Liu_Gongzi right.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Extreme close-up macro shot, 1:1 scale, top-down fixed view. A_Qingsi's hand emerges from sleeve holding Tea_Bottle_Prop steadily. Bottle details sharp: "100年润发" engraving legible, celadon glaze reflects ambient light, wooden cap texture distinct. Background dims to emphasize prop self-illumination. Top light highlights釉面 reflections.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to Medium close-up, 85mm lens, frontal eye-level, fixed. A_Qingsi holds Tea_Bottle_Prop against chest, gaze determined toward Liu_Gongzi, raising bottle to display. Dark stone wall background blurred, focus stacked on bottle and her face. Soft concentrated light on bottle makes it visual center.
<d>[Chinese] 此乃百年控油小茶瓶，专解头油之困！</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to Close-up, 85mm lens, side 45-degree, slight upward tilt. Tracking small hand movement. Action sequence: A_Qingsi tilts bottle, pouring pale green liquid onto Liu_Gongzi's stuck hair roots and her own contact zones. Fingers rapidly rub mixture into strands. Fine bubbles appear with popping sounds. Grease visibly lifts off, hair strands separate one by one. Bottle mouth emits faint shimmer indicating quick-dry feature. Backlight outlines finger contours and droplets.
[Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the camera cuts to Macro detail shot, 1:1 scale, top-down fixed. Water evaporates rapidly in air, transforming texture: previously clumped hair now individual strands floating independently, dry to touch, regaining silk-like luster. Particle flow effects surround each strand. Lighting brightens softly, warm golden tones begin replacing cold blues.
[Shot 5] At 00:14.000, the camera cuts to Medium shot, 50mm lens, side 90-degree, eye-level, fixed. Liu_Gongzi's eyes widen, he tentatively touches now-smooth hair strands, expression shifting from pain to delight. He grips hair firmly preparing to descend. In background left, A_Qingsi smiles nodding approvingly. Warm fill light enhances Liu_Gongzi's face brightness.
<d>[Chinese] 好！这下清爽多了，竟已干透！</d>
overall_soundscape:
Porcelain clink when taking bottle, cloth rustle, liquid spray hiss, bubble pop-crackle, soft wind brushing clean hair, hopeful rising tone.
non_diegetic_music:
None

## 【投喂单元 3/4】
duration: 12
subject_definitions:
<Subject> A_Qingsi: Standing atop tower, watching descent. Hair fully transformed: voluminous, airy, silky, no longer burdensome.
</Subject>
<Subject> Liu_Gongzi: Descending smoothly using hair as rope. Posture confident, fluid motion.
</Subject>
<Subject> Ancient_Tower_Interior / Tower_Top_Edge: Transition zone between interior darkness and exterior sky.
</Subject>
summary:
With hair cleaned and strengthened, Liu_Gongzi slides down effortlessly along A_Qingsi's long locks. The descent is smooth, fast, and graceful, demonstrating the product's efficacy. He lands safely outside while A_Qingsi remains above, her hair flowing beautifully in the wind.
retention_analysis:
Motion continuity critical here: start position matches Unit 2 end (gripping hair), landing position sets up Unit 4 (standing below). Hair physics updated: lightweight, flexible, supportive. Lighting progresses from indoor cool to outdoor warm dusk tones.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Medium shot, 35mm lens, side 45-degree, eye-level, slow horizontal pan. Liu_Gongzi grips vertical hair strands firmly with both hands, center of gravity lowering, ready to slide. Gaze directed downward at landing spot. A_Qingsi visible far above on tower edge, watching him. Light from above creates strong chiaroscuro on moving figure.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to Wide shot, ultra-wide 14mm lens, low-angle upward tilt, fixed. Full view of descent: Liu_Gongzi slides rapidly down the column of hair, robes fluttering upward due to speed. Motion blur minimal, clarity high. A_Qingsi shrinks visually at top. Intense Tyndall beams cut through dust along path, highlighting trajectory.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to Close tracking shot, 85mm lens, side profile, handheld shake simulating speed. Focus on hand-hair interface: strands glide smoothly without snagging, exhibiting perfect flexibility and strength. Liu_Gongzi's face relaxed, confident smile forming. Even bright illumination on skin.
[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the camera cuts to Long shot, high-angle bird's-eye view from tower top looking down. Liu_Gongzi nearing ground level, body intact and poised. A_Qingsi stands at edge, her long hair cascading like waterfall, spreading elegantly in breeze. Distance increases vertically. Dusk light begins seeping in, warming overall atmosphere.
overall_soundscape:
Whooshing wind rush, clothes flapping violently, swift sliding friction sound fading to silence upon landing, birds chirping faintly in distance.
non_diegetic_music:
None

## 【投喂单元 4/4】
duration: 12
subject_definitions:
<Subject> A_Qingsi: Heroic pose atop tower, backlit by sunset. Hair glowing gold-edged, airy, majestic.
</Subject>
<Subject> Liu_Gongzi: Safe on ground, admiring upward.
</Subject>
<Subject> Open_Sky_Dusk: Vast outdoor space before sunset. Layered thin clouds, orange-yellow and pale blue gradient sky, extremely clear visibility, soft diffused warm sunlight.
</Subject>
summary:
Final resolution and brand message delivery. Liu_Gongzi lands safely and looks up. A_Qingsi turns back smiling gracefully amid golden hour light. Her hair shines with idealized beauty—silky, voluminous, radiant. End card focuses on hair texture and VO tagline reinforcing product benefit.
retention_analysis:
Emotional peak achieved: relief → admiration → aspiration. Visual style elevated to commercial polish: PBR silk-gold finish, particle sparkles, cinematic bokeh. Composition balanced: vertical axis alignment maintained until final cutaway.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Medium shot, 35mm lens, side 45-degree, eye-level, slow pan. Liu_Gongzi lands solidly on open ground beneath tower, feet planting firmly. He raises head to gaze upward at tower top. Background: vast Open_Sky_Dusk with layered clouds. Sunset rim-light defines his silhouette warmly.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to Wide shot, ultra-wide 14mm lens, low-angle upward tilt, fixed. A_Qingsi stands proudly on tower edge, facing wind. Her once-heavy hair now flows like liquid silk, every strand separated, filled with airiness. Sunlight filters through gaps creating halo effect around her slender figure. Strong backlight separation.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to Close-up, 85mm lens, side 45-degree, slight downward tilt, slow push. A_Qingsi turns head back with gentle smile, eyes sparkling clear. Hair arcs gracefully in wind, catching sunbeams that form visible Tyndall rays within strands. Particles sparkle like diamond dust at tips. Background melts into warm bokeh orbs. Reverse light paints golden edges on hair. Her lips remain completely closed as the voice-over plays.
<d>[Chinese] 百年润发，控油蓬松，秀发自在轻盈。</d>
[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the camera cuts to Macro freeze-frame, 85mm lens, frontal eye-level, static. Extreme close-up of single lock of hair: microscopic texture visible, glossy PBR material rendering, floating gently against abstract gradient sky backdrop (orange-blue). No objects, only pure aesthetic sensation. Fade out slowly.
overall_soundscape:
Soft footsteps landing, sustained wind chime-like whisper, magical shimmer sound accompanying VO, music swell resolving quietly.
non_diegetic_music:
Gentle uplifting orchestral underscore starting at Shot 3, fading after final line.
